abstract: Maintains market reputation benchmarks and historical client satisfaction metrics
system_message:
You are Offshore operations strategist (STRAT). The offshore operations strategist oversees market reputation benchmarks, past charterer feedback, and structural aviation certifications across candidate offshore service vessel fleets.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Aviation helideck certification（HELIDECK）
information_points.content:
STRAT-HELIDECK-B31：The structural platform aviation helideck certificate for Celtic Horizon Marine Services designates a certified helideck D-value diameter rating of 23.5 m.
STRAT-HELIDECK-P8Y：Baltic Wind Voyager Fleet Group holds an aviation helideck certificate specifying a certified helideck D-value diameter rating of 21.0 m for its structural platform.
STRAT-HELIDECK-5RQ：Under its aviation helideck certificate for the vessel platform, North Sea Guardian Offshore Consortium possesses a certified helideck D-value diameter rating of 18.5 m.

information_points.title: Maintains market reputation benchmarks and historical client satisfaction metrics（BENCHREP）
information_points.content:
STRAT-BENCHREP-LI0：According to the annual offshore charterers review survey evaluating the past 3 years across European offshore wind operators, North Sea Guardian Offshore Consortium recorded an average historical client satisfaction benchmark of 78 points on a normalized 100-point scale.
STRAT-BENCHREP-JFO：The past 3-year annual offshore charterers review survey across European offshore wind operators indicates that Baltic Wind Voyager Fleet Group achieved an average historical client satisfaction benchmark of 78 points on a normalized 100-point scale.
STRAT-BENCHREP-XEA：Based on the annual offshore charterers review survey covering European offshore wind operators over the past 3 years, Celtic Horizon Marine Services attained an average historical client satisfaction benchmark of 94 points on a normalized 100-point scale.
